name: Murga
classification_notes: A festive display face named after the Latin American carnival dance, drawn from four decades of Koziupa's label lettering experience.
summary: A festive display face named for murga, the Latin American carnival dance.
description: Murga carries decades of Angel Koziupa's label-lettering experience into a lively, carnival-flavoured display face, suited to packaging and party branding with an energetic beach or surf feel.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos says Murga is a dance, it's Latin, it's carnival.

name: Newbery Sans
classification_notes: Draws from E. Nerdinger's German instructional lettering, built as a usable workhorse system across three widths and seven weights with real italics.
summary: A contrasted workhorse sans drawing on E. Nerdinger's German instructional lettering, spanning three widths and seven weights.
description: Newbery Sans invokes the spirit of German lettering design while carrying a personality all its own, built for everything from corporate branding to editorial. From condensed thin to expanded black, each weight includes real italics, alternate glyphs and a complete small caps set with extended Latin support.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos calls Newbery Sans an elegant, functional family that will effortlessly meet the demands of the screen and printed page.

name: NoMo Sans
designer: Agustin Pizarro Maire, Guillermo Vizzari, Yanina Arabena
classification_notes: A single-axis variable super family pushed to extreme condensed and expanded masters, rooted in an irreverent, improvised design brief rather than a neutral text sans.
summary: A witty, one-axis super family pushed from super condensed to super wide, with a playful, mould-breaking personality.
description: NoMo Sans started as an irreverent, mischievous exploration years ago, revisited in a remixed version that added extreme masters at both ends of the width axis. The whole system had to be reworked to swing across such extremes, resulting in a one-axis variable family with genuine attitude.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos calls NoMo Sans a witty and expansive super type family that hits the page like a jazz solo, full of attitude and clearly breaking the mould.

name: Nougat Script
classification_notes: One font file offering four distinct writing modes (base script, two glyphic swash alternatives, small caps) via OpenType features rather than separate weight files.
summary: A four-mode elegant script begun in 2010, offering base, two swash-alternative glyphic styles and small caps within one file.
description: Nougat Script's first glyphs were drawn in 2010 and presented at Tipos Latinos, where it was selected among 70 of the best fonts, before a major 2018 restart added complexity and new modes. Its fresh, relaxed lettering attitude combines with typographic harshness for elegant text compositions.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos traces Nougat Script to a 2010 tribute to the designer's daughter, later restarted in 2018 with far greater complexity.

name: Olin
classification_notes: A high-contrast serif with a diagonal rhythm built for editorial and hospitality identity work, carrying a Mediterranean gourmet character.
summary: A high-contrast Mediterranean-flavoured serif with a diagonal rhythm, built for magazine headlines and restaurant identities.
description: Olin glides like a knife through butter, smooth and precise, blending elegance with warmth across five weights and matching italics. It supports a large range of Latin languages and comes in variable format.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes Olin as inviting readers not just to look, but to almost taste every word, with a subtle Mediterranean aroma.

name: Organica Pro
classification_notes: Deliberately resists serif/sans/slab classification, built on a curvilinear, asymmetrical organic structure rather than the typical straight-stem alphabetic skeleton.
summary: A curvilinear, deliberately unclassifiable semi-serif/semi-sans built on an organic rather than stick-and-ball structure.
description: Organica proposes a subtle, sophisticated curvilinear anatomy in place of the usual vertical-column letter structure, its expressive terminals challenging easy classification as serif or sans, text or display. Six stylistic sets let it shift character across editorial and branding use.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos poses Organica's central question directly: is this a serif or a sans font, a semi-serif or semi-sans, for text or display? All answers are valid.

name: Oxida
classification_notes: A rough, rusty-edged calligraphic script built for large sizes, sister to the smoother, more refined Inoxida.
summary: A softly-read but attention-commanding rustic script, a common sight on organic and vegetable food packaging.
description: Oxida adds a slightly coarse and rusty aura to the foundry's usual script elegance, making it indispensable for large-size use in poster design, book covers and culinary packaging. A softer, more refined sister font, Inoxida, reworks the same idea for more sophisticated packaging needs.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes Oxida as combining Angel Koziupa's unmistakable hand with Alejandro Paul's technical expertise, adding a slightly coarse and rusty aura.

name: Partner Family
classification_notes: A single variable file where sans and serif coexist on a continuous axis rather than two separate families, so classified by its sans-rooted origin though it spans both.
summary: A variable superfamily where sans and serif live on a single continuous axis, born from a custom commission for a Buenos Aires neo-bistro.
description: Partner started as a two-weight sans for a neo-bistro's custom identity, then grew into nine weights with true italics before a serif axis was added without fracturing the underlying structure. The result lets sans and serif coexist within one variable file, moving from light to black and from serif to sans without a seam, suited to gastronomy, fashion and editorial work.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes Partner as connected by a continuous axis that moves from sans to serif and from light to black without a seam, subtle, elegant and timeless.

name: Paz
classification_notes: A squarish four-weight industrial family ranging from extreme hairline to black, built for headline-led editorial design.
summary: A squarish, four-weight industrial sans running from extreme hairline to black, built for headline-led editorial design.
description: Paz is ideal for editorial headlines where type plays a major role in the overall design, its squarish forms giving it a techno, corporate edge.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes Paz as a squarish 4-weight industrial family, ideal for editorial headlines where type plays a major role.

name: Piedra Pro
classification_notes: A fear-inducing, rocky-textured display face built for over-the-top intimidation rather than legible text use.
summary: A rocky, fear-inducing display face of galvanised triceps and chiselled jawlines.
description: Piedra's stylistic alternates let it disregard convention and spit pebbles on the sidewalk, suited to monster, horror and comic-adjacent branding.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos calls Piedra the rocky, fear-inducing face of galvanized triceps and überchiseled jawlines, be very intimidated.

name: Piel Script
classification_notes: Born from requests to typeset tattoos using Burgues Script and Adios, developed into its own dedicated tattoo-lettering script.
summary: A dedicated tattoo-lettering script, born from repeated requests to adapt other Sudtipos scripts for body art.
description: Piel Script grew out of unusual, deeply personal requests to typeset tattoos commemorating friends, family, births and deaths using existing Sudtipos scripts, prompting a purpose-built design for that very personal kind of typography.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos frames Piel Script as growing from personal branding requests, as literally personal and branding as the expression can get.

name: Pinguino
classification_notes: Takes Koziupa's condensed brush approach upright and narrow, softened with a feminine touch compared to his usual exotic brush scripts.
summary: A narrow, upright brush script with softened corners and a feminine touch, at home on both coffee and fruit-juice packaging.
description: Pinguino takes Angel Koziupa's familiar brush upright and narrow, softening its corners for a distinctly feminine feel while keeping his signature calligraphic character.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos says Pinguino would feel at home on sobering coffee packaging just as it would on a bouncy mixed-fruit juice bottle.

name: Platinus Script Pro
classification_notes: Traces invitation scripts from 1930s commercial lettering through 1980s-90s greeting-card conventions, built from single-stroke base characters in two weights.
summary: An invitation script tracing the evolution from 1930s commercial lettering to 1980s-90s greeting-card scripts, in two weights.
description: Platinus Script Pro's base characters are mostly single strokes, some drawn top-down and some bottom-up, emphasising casual but precise fluidity magnified by loops and swashes throughout. Over 570 characters per font and full Latin-language support suit product packaging and celebration stationery.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos frames Platinus Script Pro as adapting conventional calligraphic methods from the last two centuries into modern digital scripts, a Sudtipos tradition.

name: Playa
classification_notes: A colour font built from illustrator Javirroyo's lettering, sold with both a colour SVG version and a black-and-white OTF.
summary: A sun-drenched colour font born from illustrator Javirroyo's beach-themed lettering.
description: Playa is drawn as if water hits sand and breaks into a thousand shining drops, shifting its colour and appearance in the light. It ships as a colour SVG font alongside a standard black-and-white OTF for wider compatibility.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos says Playa is a typeface born under the sun, to be used only in a good mood.

name: Plethora
classification_notes: Inspired by Julius Herriet's patented Old Style Ornamented type for the Bruce Type Foundry, distinguished by top-tailed connecting ligatures across nine weights.
summary: A nine-weight old-style serif inspired by Julius Herriet's patented Old Style Ornamented ligatures for the Bruce Type Foundry.
description: Plethora extrapolates Herriet's unique connecting ligatures, where letters carry small top tails that link them together, into a full variable family with additional interconnected letters and alternates. True to its name, it means a large or excessive amount, reflected in its extensive ligature system.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos traces Plethora to Julius Herriet's late-nineteenth-century patented Old Style Ornamented type design for the Bruce Type Foundry.

name: Plumero
classification_notes: Replaces the discipline of old lettering with fresh, joyful swashes, positioned as the wild, playful side of calligraphy.
summary: A wild, playful side of calligraphy, replacing disciplined old-style elegance with fresh, joyful swashes.
description: Plumero is attractive and care-free, catching the eye and leaving an indelible impression of its unmistakable signature quality.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos calls Plumero the wild, playful side of calligraphy, care-free and eye-catching.

name: Poem Script
classification_notes: Reproduces the late-nineteenth-century American "Italian Alphabet" pen-script style, where stress and shading sit opposite their normal placement.
summary: A late nineteenth-century American Italian Hand revival, a reverse-stress penmanship style descended from seventeenth-century French batarde.
description: Poem Script conjures the confusingly-named Italian Alphabet, whose shaded strokes sit in reversed positions compared to normal calligraphy, historically requiring the pen held horizontal to the baseline. A Basic tier sits alongside the Pro version, plus an Ornaments companion.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos calls Poem Script a mixed collection of interpretations conjuring a late nineteenth century American pen script style, showcasing phenomenal historic hand skill.

name: Politica
classification_notes: A sturdy, straight-to-the-point sans superfamily extending across Cyrillic, Greek, Baltic, Turkish and Central European character sets.
summary: A sturdy, straight-to-the-point monoline sans superfamily extending across Cyrillic, Greek, Baltic and Central European scripts.
description: Politica was built as an answer to overused sans faces, modern and direct enough to cover the contradictions of twenty-first-century politics. Its OpenType variations extend the character set well beyond Latin, giving genuinely global reach.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos says with Politica, the globe is yours, a sturdy, modern and straight-to-the-point sans to cover the issues.

name: Ponche
classification_notes: A warm, upbeat colour font based on Juliana Pedemonte's lettering, sold with both colour and black-and-white OTF versions.
summary: A fun, warm, upbeat colour font designed to make social posts, headers and posters pop.
description: Ponche suits any project that wants an eye-catching effect, from social media posts to website headers, ads, posters and stationery designs. Its colour palette can be customised and it comes with alternate characters for extra variety.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos calls Ponche a fun, warm, upbeat color font that will make personal or commercial projects pop with its unique graphic look.

name: Popolare
classification_notes: A colour font based on Martín Laksman's lettering, inspired by markets, architecture, futurism and football rather than a single stylistic tradition.
summary: A colour font inspired by popular markets, architecture, futurism and football, linking everyday early twentieth-century culture.
description: Popolare unites the popular things that shape everyday life into a linear interweaving of forms, its palette drawn from the customs, tastes and scents of markets and popular culture from the first half of the twentieth century.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes Popolare as inspired by markets and architecture, futurism and football, uniting the popular things that shape us.

name: Portuguesa
classification_notes: Three complementary fonts (Script, Caps, Icons) inspired by old Portuguese packaging and store signage, sold together as one system rather than pure weights.
summary: A three-part script system inspired by old Portuguese packaging and store signage, pairing a script with caps and azulejo-tile icons.
description: Portuguesa Script carries a friendly, rhythmic personality for titles and short text, Portuguesa Caps adds small caps and ligatures that contrast with the script, and Portuguesa Icons recalls Portugal's legendary blue tiles for patterns and borders. Together they suit stationery, tableware and commercial products wanting a warm, sunny character.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes Portuguesa as inspired by the graphic spirit of old packaging and store signs of Portugal, transmitting the warm and sunny sound of the Portuguese language.

name: Prangs
classification_notes: Revives a high-contrast Didone italic from an alphabet in Louis Prang's sign-painter instructional book, distinguished by an almost entirely cursive-connected lowercase.
summary: A high-contrast Didone italic revival from an alphabet in Louis Prang's sign-painter instructional book, winner of a Communication Arts Certificate of Excellence.
description: Prangs revives an alphabet Louis Prang, the "father of the American Christmas card", published for sign painters, lithographers and illuminators, an alphabet simply titled "Italic" with an almost entirely cursive-connected lowercase. Three weights bring it to fashion, luxury and editorial branding.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos notes Prangs received a Certificate of Excellence at the Communication Arts Typography annual competition, drawn from Louis Prang's sign-painter instructional alphabets.

name: Presley Slab
classification_notes: Starts as a delicate contrasted serif in its lightest weight then swells into voluptuous reverse-contrast forms at its heaviest, nodding to rock'n'roll-era hairstyles.
summary: A reverse-contrast slab that swells from a delicate light weight into voluptuous, rock'n'roll-inflected black.
description: Presley Slab's heaviest weight nods to lacquered rock'n'roll hairstyles through idiosyncratic ball terminals, while its lighter weights keep a playful swagger with fewer curls. Extra Bold and Black weights make a powerful option at poster sizes, with the full range suited to editorial design and branding.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes Presley Slab as a fun, confident and contemporary palette of letters that will perfectly perform for any job, from editorial design to branding.

name: Primavera
classification_notes: A fresh, felt-tip-styled casual handwriting script in Regular and Italic, built for a lively, springtime tone.
summary: A fresh, spirited felt-tip handwriting script in two styles, built to feel like a cool spring breeze.
description: Primavera combines Angel Koziupa's playful forms with Alejandro Paul's smooth, crisp outlines for a humorous, lively typeface, well suited to food packaging labels, greeting cards and journals.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos calls Primavera a fresh and spirited take on casual handwriting, conveying freshness, young spirit and a cool spring breeze.

name: Pronto
classification_notes: A fast, breezy calligraphic handwriting script with alternates for nearly every letter, built for cafe and bistro signage.
summary: A fast, breezy calligraphic handwriting script that moves to a timeless beat, built for cafe and bistro signage.
description: Pronto's catchy rhythm and casually artful forms suit packaging, signs and menu boards alike, with alternative forms for almost every letter and wide Latin-based language support including Turkish, Central and Eastern European and Baltic.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes Pronto as a fast and breezy calligraphic handwriting font that moves to a timeless beat.

name: Proprietor
classification_notes: A tribute to hand craftsmanship across trades (barbers, baristas, sign painters, carpenters), sold as a multi-part toolkit (Script, Roman, Deco, Open, Wide, Icons) rather than a weight ladder.
summary: A craft-trades lettering toolkit born in a Moleskine notebook, celebrating barbers, baristas, carpenters and sign painters.
description: Proprietor began as pencil, paper and ink sketches, a tribute to the value of thoroughly hand-crafted work observed across Yani & Guille's clients. It bundles Script, Roman, Deco, Open and Wide styles with a companion icon set, suited to artisanal and trade-based branding.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos frames Proprietor as regaining the art behind type design, born in a Moleskine notebook as a tribute to craftsmanship.

name: Queenie
classification_notes: A reverse-contrast, fluid-shaped display face with virtually no straight lines, echoing 1960s psychedelic poster and vinyl-record graphics.
summary: A groovy, reverse-contrast display face with virtually no straight lines, echoing 1960s psychedelic posters and vinyl records.
description: Queenie's rhythmic strokes and subtly slanted stems carry a distinctly groovy character across nine weights from Thin to Heavy, plus a variable version. More than 500 glyphs including multiple numeral sets and dingbats make it built to shine in headlines and expressive large-scale layouts.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes Queenie as a playful and optimistic variable display typeface born from the vibrant, warm spirit of psychedelic graphics.

name: Questline
classification_notes: Blends Roman elegance with Gothic structural strength into a flared serif, including a dedicated set of Gothic-inspired uppercase forms.
summary: A flared serif blending Roman elegance with Gothic structural strength, reimagining medieval letterforms across 18 styles.
description: Questline balances contrast, rhythm and optical precision with consistent stroke modulation, its dedicated Gothic-inspired uppercase forms giving it a distinctive voice. Nine weights with matching italics and over 750 glyphs cover both expressive display and extended reading.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes Questline as reimagining medieval letterforms through careful research and refined craftsmanship, grounded in historical tradition.

name: Quilichao Grotesk
classification_notes: Reads as a classic neo-grotesque on the surface but is distinguished by unusual acute and grave accent treatment, developed during a period in Santander de Quilichao.
summary: A classic-reading neo-grotesque with a sturdy weight and slant axis, distinguished by unusual accent details.
description: Quilichao Grotesk looks clean and functional on a rigorous European structure at first glance, but its most distinctive detail sits in its accents, developed during a long period the designer spent in Santander de Quilichao. It works as a dependable variable font addressing a wide range of visual identity needs.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos frames Quilichao Grotesk as reflecting a shift from an inward, technique-driven practice toward a design approach shaped by place, time and listening.

name: Quotes
designer: Yanina Arabena, Guillermo Vizzari, Alejandro Paul
classification_notes: A two-part pointed-brush system (Script and Caps) built specifically for hand-written inspirational phrases and quotes rather than general text.
summary: A pointed-brush quote-lettering system pairing a free Script style with a complementary Caps set, Yanina Arabena's second Sudtipos typeface.
description: Quotes Script and Quotes Caps are designed to work together, filling spoken words with rhythm through a huge amount of alternate glyphs, ligatures and connectors. The free, spontaneous Script pairs with the more structured Caps for inspirational phrases and quote-style graphics.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes Quotes as thrilled by the pointed brush, spontaneous messages, gesture and freshness to represent inspirational phrases written by hand.

name: Referenz Grotesk
classification_notes: Draws on the type-design history of Stuttgart State Academy of Art and Design, referencing Schneidler, Reiner, Brudi, Weidemann and Heine rather than a single historical model.
summary: A German grotesque referencing the type-design history of Stuttgart State Academy of Art and Design, and designers Schneidler, Reiner, Brudi, Weidemann and Heine.
description: Referenz Grotesk emerged from extensive research into the Academy's archive, where the majority of Kurt Weidemann's estate is held alongside works by F.H. Ernst Schneidler and Walter Brudi. Some of Schneidler's freshly cast fonts, tested at the Academy's own typesetting workshop, fed directly into the research.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos calls Referenz Grotesk a typeface full of references to the type-design history of Stuttgart State Academy of Art and Design, made in Germany.

name: Reflex
classification_notes: A spurless, unicase-capable sans rooted in Bauhaus design, extended to 18 styles across Central European, Cyrillic, Greek, Turkish and Baltic scripts.
summary: A Bauhaus-rooted geometric sans with a soft aesthetic even at heavy weights, now in 18 styles with wide script support.
description: Reflex was designed as an alternative to overused pop-culture packaging types, its heavy weights staying soft and clear rather than harsh. It comes with wide linguistic support at no extra charge, including Central European, Cyrillic, Greek, Turkish and Baltic characters.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes Reflex as designed as an alternative to many overused types found on the packaging of pop culture products.

name: Regional
classification_notes: Inspired by late nineteenth-century Old Style Bold models from various type foundries, distinguished by a unique diagonal R that inspired its alternates.
summary: A 27-style Old Style Bold workhorse serif inspired by late nineteenth-century foundry models, distinguished by a unique diagonal R.
description: Regional's unique diagonal R inspired many of the alternates included across the set, running from a delicate thin condensed to an exaggerated expanded black. A complementary one-file variable format ships with the complete set, aimed at magazines, packaging labels and posters.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos calls Regional a solid workhorse type family of 27 styles that merges the past with the present, useful for a wide range of designs.

name: Replete Sans
classification_notes: Inspired by the mixture of Art Deco and Bauhaus-influenced street typography found across global metropolitan cities, with a companion inline Deco style.
summary: A geometric sans inspired by the Art Deco and Bauhaus street typography of global metropolitan cities.
description: Replete Sans draws on how Art Deco lettering coexists with Bauhaus-influenced modernism on storefronts and signage from Shanghai to Buenos Aires, sometimes in harmony and sometimes in ideological opposition. A Deco and Deco Inline companion style extends its decorative range alongside the core weight ramp.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes Replete Sans as inspired by the mixture of aesthetics and philosophies found on the streets of metropolitan cities the world over.

name: Ribbonetta
classification_notes: Built from a brush imitating a fine-point copperplate nib, its irregular brush-drawn quality deliberately kept rather than smoothed away.
summary: A classic yet modern script named for the ribbon-like intersections within its letterforms, drawn from a brush imitating a copperplate nib.
description: Ribbonetta's shapes come from a brush aspiring to draw fine English or copperplate letters, and rather than smoothing over the slightly irregular lines this leaves, the design builds on that gesture as its foundation. The result reads as serious, graceful, witty and youthful all at once.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes Ribbonetta as classic yet modern, agile yet playful, serious, graceful, witty, elegant and youthful.

name: Ricotta Script
classification_notes: A sturdy brush script with minimal excess movement, aimed at dairy and food packaging rather than expressive display use.
summary: A sturdy, compact brush script with just enough movement, built for dairy and pizza packaging.
description: Ricotta's movement is effective and integral to its expression, at once compact, lush and eye-catching, with subtle details placed in just the right spots for bright, cheerful food packaging.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos says Ricotta should feel at home among the bright and cheerful colors of dairy product and pizza packaging.

name: Rigatoni
subcategory: Didone display serif with stencil variant
classification_notes: Based on a German mid-century lettering specimen by Nerdinger, a Didone display family with a notably readable lower case and a two-weight stencil variant.
summary: A highly readable Didone display serif based on a German mid-century lettering specimen, with a two-weight stencil variant.
description: Rigatoni's tall letterforms and sturdy serifs give it a noble bearing in all caps, while the large x-height and spacious counters keep the lower case welcoming. Sudtipos commissioned 3D visualisations from designer Esteban Diácono for its intended use on restaurant menus and food packaging.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos calls Rigatoni a didone display family with exceptional readability, expanded from a German mid-century lettering specimen by Nerdinger.

name: Rolling Pen
classification_notes: Rooted in Palmer and Spencerian school penmanship, sold as a multi-part set (Basic One, Basic Two, Curly, Complete, Extras) rather than a weight ladder, winner of a Communication Arts Certificate of Excellence.
summary: A Palmer and Spencerian school-penmanship script sold as a multi-part set, winner of a Communication Arts Certificate of Excellence.
description: Rolling Pen sits at the intersection of calligraphy history and pop technology, its monoline hairline strokes recalling school-taught penmanship methods now rare in a command-Z world. The set splits into Basic One, Basic Two, Curly and Extras components, letting users combine parts to taste.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos notes Rolling Pen received a Certificate of Excellence at the Communication Arts Typography annual competition.

name: Romy
classification_notes: Combines comedy, graffiti and greeting-card lettering conventions into one casual handwriting style, with a companion Caps set.
summary: A fresh, humorous casual handwriting script combining comedy, graffiti and greeting-card lettering.
description: Romy reads like refrigerator notes crossed with greeting cards, its unmistakable lettering carrying a friendly and lively personality across Regular and Caps styles.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos calls Romy a fresh take on casual handwriting, combining aspects of comedy, graffiti, greeting cards and refrigerator notes.

name: Rondana
classification_notes: A geometric sans with a deliberately non-Bauhausian spirit, its arcs deviating from ruler-and-compass construction toward a subtly squared, organic shape.
summary: A retro-futuristic geometric sans with deliberately non-Bauhausian arcs and unexpected shapes for E, g and the ampersand.
description: Rondana pays tribute to 1960s and 70s retro-futuristic aesthetics while intentionally avoiding dull, obvious ruler-and-compass geometry, giving it a more organic, extroverted personality. Non-standard but legible shapes for certain letters give it a particular flavour, especially in its italic variants.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos calls Rondana a typographic tribute to the retro-futuristic aesthetics of the 1960s and 70s, an exercise in purity of line with a decidedly non-Bauhausian spirit.

name: Salamat
classification_notes: Grew from sketches inspired by a trip to the Philippines, an expressive calligraphic script with wide swash capitals and contextual ligatures.
summary: A humanistic, expressive brush script inspired by Joluvian's time in the Philippines, his second typeface after Zulia Pro.
description: Salamat evolved from a quick sketch into a stylised typography with wide swash capitals, contextual ligatures and ascending and descending starting and ending letters. It gives users freedom to build words, sentences and stylised paragraphs.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos traces Salamat to Joluvian's trip to the Philippines, giving the user freedom with type the way the Philippines gave Joluvian freedom.

name: Santino
classification_notes: A rounded, monoline post-Bauhaus geometric display face with smooth extremes rather than sharp geometric precision.
summary: A rounded, monoline post-Bauhaus geometric display face with a touch of modern sensuality, named for the designer's son.
description: Santino keeps smooth extremes throughout its geometric structure, giving it a softened, minimalist character suited to magazine and music-related design.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos notes Santino is named after Ariel "Negro" Di Lisio's son.

name: Savior Sans
classification_notes: The third collaboration between Sudtipos and Estudio Vástago, a simple, open-shaped contemporary take on traditional sans structure.
summary: A simple, open-shaped contemporary sans across nine weights and three widths, the third Sudtipos/Vástago collaboration.
description: Savior Sans offers a contemporary look at traditional sans fonts, its open shapes giving a different texture that works across web design, packaging and branding. A variable version allows multiple options for adapting to different composition solutions.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos calls Savior Sans a contemporary look at traditional sans fonts, maintaining a clear identity across each of its weights.

name: Scrapbooker
classification_notes: A six-font set (Sans, Sans Italic, Script, Little, Tuscan, Icons) built specifically for memory-album and scrapbook design rather than a single letterform system.
summary: A six-font hand-lettering set built for scrapbooking and memory-album design, following on from the Distillery Set.
description: Scrapbooker multiplies the possibilities for the design demographic that makes albums of memories from papers, photos, letters and dried petals. The set's words play a key role in strengthening that collage, clarifying concepts and solidifying memories across its Sans, Script, Little and Tuscan styles.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes Scrapbooker as growing from Carolina Marando and Alejandro Paul's earlier collaboration on the bestselling Distillery Set.

name: Seashore Pro
classification_notes: Draws on an unconventional left-leaning (backslant) late-nineteenth-century penmanship style used by high-society scribes, rarer than Spencerian or standard ornamental hands.
summary: An elegant, graceful script with thicker horizontals, drawn from a rare left-leaning nineteenth-century penmanship style.
description: Seashore's unconventional backslant conveyed true sophistication in its day, mastered only after the more common business, Spencerian and ornamental styles. Over 900 glyphs of swash capitals, alternative endings and contextual ligatures suit brief display applications like names and titling.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes Seashore as inspired by an unconventional, left-leaning penmanship style of the late nineteenth century used for certificates and high-society correspondence.

name: Sedna
classification_notes: Draws on the Dutch text type tradition, particularly the functional intelligence of Swift, reworked with a less anatomically rigid, more flexible structure.
summary: A sturdy yet flexible text serif drawing on the Dutch tradition, particularly Swift's functional intelligence, across sixteen styles.
description: Sedna balances technical precision with expressive warmth through subtle micro-aesthetic decisions throughout the alphabet, giving it a distinctive voice without compromising usability. Eight weights with matching italics adapt naturally to text, branding and interface design.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes Sedna as designed for performance, clarity and character, moving the Dutch text tradition toward a more flexible, contemporary interpretation.

name: Seferis
classification_notes: An uppercase-only typeface influenced by the classical imprint of incised lettering, given modern proportions and an epic character.
summary: An uppercase-only display face influenced by classical incised lettering, carrying elegance, sophistication and an epic character.
description: Seferis offers a wide repertoire of ligatures, stylistic alternatives and swashes with substantial Latin language coverage. It works well across posters, logos, magazine headlines and album and book covers.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos says Seferis's structure, proportions and aesthetic show modern features that give it elegance, sophistication, inner strength and an epic character.

name: Semilla
classification_notes: Distils the work of Bentele, an obscure early-1950s German lettering artist, into a modern cursive with ball terminals, winner of a Communication Arts Certificate of Excellence.
summary: A ball-terminal cursive script distilling the work of Bentele, an obscure 1950s German lettering artist, later revisited in Bowling Script and Hopfen.
description: Semilla grew out of the designer's long-standing obsessions with packaging and hand lettering, taking a lettering artist's specific historical style and turning it into a versatile, fresh display cursive suited to stationery and editorial work.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos notes Semilla received a Certificate of Excellence at the Communication Arts Typography annual competition.

name: Sinfonieta
classification_notes: A methodical, disciplined brush script built to avoid clashing with busy branding layouts, precise enough for logotype and wordmark work.
summary: A methodical, disciplined brush script that accentuates class and comfort without clashing with busy branding layouts.
description: Sinfonieta's elegant strokes suit branding or packaging projects requiring a clear, simple artistic alphabet among many design elements, with alternates that help with the precision needed for logotypes and wordmarks.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos says Sinfonieta accentuates the collage just enough to convey class and comfort, art and elegance.

name: SL Borges
classification_notes: A picture/icon font rather than a letterform typeface, part of the Icons of Icons gallery, synthesising Jorge Luis Borges's themes into pictorial glyphs.
summary: A non-alphabetic iconographic font paying homage to Jorge Luis Borges, synthesising his obsessions with infinity, labyrinths and libraries into pictorial glyphs.
description: SL Borges was sharply depicted by Augusto Costhanzo as part of the Icons of Icons gallery, reducing Borges's grand literary themes and his more human side, cats, politics and tango, into an original True Type icon library rather than a conventional alphabet.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos calls SL Borges a homage to Jorge Luis Borges, synthesizing to icons the big themes that obsessed him: the infinite, labyrinths, libraries, identity.

name: SL Che
classification_notes: A picture/icon font rather than a letterform typeface, part of the Icons of Icons gallery, offering heroic, laughing and cool variations of the iconic Che Guevara photograph.
summary: A non-alphabetic iconographic font offering heroic, laughing and cool variations of the iconic Che Guevara image, by Jorge Alderete.
description: SL Che unfolds like a fan of thousands of "Che" variations, a development plentiful in metaphor drawn from the endlessly reproduced photograph that made Guevara a universal icon.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes SL Che as taking part in the Icons of Icons Gallery developed by SinergiaLab for Sudtipos.

name: SL Cortazar
classification_notes: A picture/icon font rather than a letterform typeface, part of the Icons of Icons gallery, portraying Julio Cortázar's obsessions in pictorial form.
summary: A non-alphabetic iconographic font portraying Julio Cortázar's obsessions with music, women and politics in pictorial form.
description: SL Cortázar describes the universe of obsessions of the unclassifiable Argentine writer through Facundo Nicolás Velilla's brilliant icon creations, revealing the edges of an intense daily life.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes SL Cortázar as taking part in the Icons of Icons Gallery developed by SinergiaLab for Sudtipos.

name: SL Gardel
classification_notes: A picture/icon font rather than a letterform typeface, part of the Icons of Icons gallery, built in the modulated trace style of Buenos Aires tango graphics.
summary: A non-alphabetic iconographic font honouring tango singer Carlos Gardel, built in the modulated trace style of Buenos Aires tango graphics.
description: SL Gardel synthesises the seduction, tango and magic of the "creole thrush" through Natalia Español's exclusive icons, reflecting his Buenos Aires through the tango spirit.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos calls SL Gardel a tribute to the genial tango singer Carlos Gardel, portrayed with proverbial slenderness.

name: So Prolix
classification_notes: A monoline cursive rooted in school-taught penmanship conventions rather than a broad-nib calligraphic style.
summary: A monoline school-cursive script rooted in classroom penmanship conventions.
description: So Prolix keeps a consistent, even monoline stroke throughout, giving it the disciplined feel of a taught cursive hand rather than a free calligraphic style.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos presents So Prolix as a monoline cursive script drawing on classic school penmanship conventions.

name: Speakeasy
classification_notes: A five-font thematic toolkit (Script, Gothic, Modern, Flare, Sans) built for menus and liquor labels, originally commissioned for a Buenos Aires speakeasy bar.
summary: A five-font menu and liquor-label toolkit originally commissioned for the most famous speakeasy bar in Buenos Aires.
description: Speakeasy contains a connected script (with two ways to join letters), a minor wedge serif, a flare serif, a sans serif and a bold Didone, all with small caps. The script's seed came from a German lettering book, while the other fonts reflect early twentieth-century advertising conventions, together suited to menus, coffee branding and restaurant signage.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes Speakeasy as a 5-font combo thematically built as a toolset for designing menus and liquor labels.

name: Speckle
classification_notes: A three-part colour font set exploring the interaction of illustration and typography, sold as colour and black-and-white OTF versions.
summary: A set of three colour fonts exploring the interaction between illustration and typography, full of life and movement.
description: Speckle plays with the idea of mixing seemingly incompatible disciplines, like oil and water, to create highly interesting and attractive shapes with personality and authenticity.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes Speckle as inspired by the interaction of two seemingly different disciplines, illustration and typography.

name: Sporty Pro
classification_notes: A geometric, modular sans built explicitly for sports branding, offered in square, rounded, Shadow and Inline treatments across condensed and expanded widths.
summary: A geometric, modular sports sans inspired by Argentine football jerseys, in square, rounded, Shadow and Inline treatments.
description: Sporty was designed after a local team's jersey used a Sudtipos font, aiming for versatility well beyond jerseys, scoreboards and stadium wayfinding. Four styles from square to rounded, plus Shadow and Inline options, each carry a set of miscellaneous ornaments.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes Sporty as having a geometric and modular structure with many potential applications that far exceed jerseys, score boards and stadium wayfinding.

name: Statement Sans
classification_notes: A neo-humanist sans with grotesque and industrial influence, developed specifically to perform in UX/UI and corporate interface contexts.
summary: A versatile neo-humanist sans with grotesque and industrial influence, built to perform in UX/UI and editorial contexts alike.
description: Statement Sans spans nine weights with matching real italics, extended Latin language support and both classic and old-style figures, plus a one-file variable font. It suits corporate interfaces and editorial web and print layouts equally.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos created Statement Sans in the spirit of modern neo humanistic fonts, with a deep grotesk and industrial influence discoverable throughout the system.

name: Steak
classification_notes: Digitises a decades-old Alf Becker sign-lettering alphabet, offered in three thematic cooking-style variants rather than a weight ladder.
summary: An Alf Becker sign-lettering revival offered in three cooking-themed variants, Barbecue, Braised and Smoked.
description: Steak revisits a decades-old Alf Becker alphabet the designer had long kept in his sights, ahead of earlier projects like Buffet Script, Whomp and Storefront. The result suits butcher shops, food branding and vintage American advertising-style packaging.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes Steak as digging up decades-old sign lettering and reconciling it with contemporary typography.

name: Storefront Pro
classification_notes: Rooted in an incomplete Alf Becker alphabet sample, its majuscules following the natural evolution of nineteenth-century scripts while its alternates leap into contemporary sign-making.
summary: A sign-painter's script imagining what 1920s-30s American sign artists would create with today's lettering technology.
description: Storefront layers on the usual Sudtipos overdose of alternates and swashes to give typesetting that elusive handmade impression, its main shapes rooted in nineteenth-century script evolution while its variants nod to contemporary sign-making and packaging.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos frames Storefront as what prolific 1920s and 1930s American sign painters would have created with today's lettering and type technologies.

name: Suave Script Pro
classification_notes: Based on disconnected calligraphy from a 1950s how-to lettering book, its dancing uppercase named for Latin dance styles, in two weights.
summary: A smooth, sun-tanned 1950s-inspired script whose dancing uppercase nods to Samba, Tango, Mambo and Candombe.
description: Suave Script's lowercase flows like honey, at once fashionable, human and creative. The Pro version adds endings, ligatures and support for Western and Eastern European, Baltic, Turkish, Maltese and Celtic languages.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos calls Suave Script a rare gem depicting the sweet hustle and bustle of life of a history-rich urbanism.

name: Sudestada
classification_notes: A distinctive handwritten script whose alternate weight provides a large number of lowercase variations for more realistic handwritten text.
summary: A distinctive handwritten script with an alternate weight offering extra lowercase variation for realistic handwritten text.
description: Sudestada's OpenType version gives access to a large number of stylistic alternates and swashes through standard typographic controls, keeping handwritten text looking natural and varied.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes Sudestada as a typeface with distinctive handwritten style and personality.

name: Sugar Pie
classification_notes: Grew from experiments testing whether Candy Script could work as an italic, ending up as its own distinct sloped brush script rather than a true Candy Script italic.
summary: A sloped brush display script born from failed attempts to build an italic version of Candy Script.
description: Sugar Pie began when a request for a Candy Script italic counterpart led to experiments at angles between 18 and 24 degrees, which showed enough promise as their own design to be pursued independently rather than shelved.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos traces Sugar Pie to reader requests for an italic counterpart to Candy Script, which led somewhere unexpected.

name: Tafel Sans Pro
classification_notes: A contemporary take on early to mid-century geometric sans conventions without strictly following their rules, distinguished by three small caps sets of different x-heights.
summary: A flexible geometric sans in eight weights with three small caps sizes (Big, Small, Petite), working at both text and display sizes.
description: Tafel keeps the intrinsic qualities of a geometric sans without following its usual strict rules, its sophisticated elegance and refined simplicity suiting corporate identities, street signage, fashion brands and luxury packaging. Old-style figures and matching italics run through all eight weights.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos calls Tafel Sudtipos' contemporary take on early- to mid-century geometric fonts, notable for its versatility across small and display sizes.

name: Tanguera
classification_notes: Koziupa and Paul's freer take on intertwined calligraphic classicism, likened to improvised tango dance steps rather than standardised patterns, drawing on Argentine fileteado traditions.
summary: A free-flowing tango-inspired script blending intertwined calligraphic classicism with Argentine fileteado decoration.
description: Tanguera reads like dancers engaged in a free form of classic Argentine tango, sometimes relaxed and soft, sometimes sharp and alert, but never losing clear communication. It provides essential rhythm to packaging design calling for clean, classical personalisation.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos compares Tanguera to dancers engaged in a free form of the classic Argentine dance, unlike the repeated patterns of standardized steps.

name: Terafile
subcategory: hi-tech sci-fi sans with ink traps
classification_notes: A hi-tech, sci-fi-inspired sans whose ink traps double as gestural detail rather than pure structural function, with mixed-construction letters like a, f, z, B, P.
summary: A hi-tech, sci-fi-inspired sans across eight weights, its ink traps doing double duty as gestural, expressive detail.
description: Terafile moves away from an entirely academic design through mixed-construction letters like a, f, z, B and P, each gaining distinct plasticity from unusual finishes. It captures the visual language of technology, industry and science fiction across its full weight range with matching italics.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes Terafile as ideally capturing in a graphic way the universe related to technology, sci-fi, industry and similar topics.

name: Theorem
classification_notes: A connected monoline script with a 1990s-twist art deco capital set, engineered through OpenType alternates for automatic optical spacing rather than free calligraphy.
summary: A connected monoline logo script with a 1990s-twist art deco capital set, engineered to self-adjust its optical spacing.
description: Theorem's lowercase characters were designed to automatically achieve the best optical spacing in typesetting, with a variety of alternates and vowel-focused ligatures doing the work behind the scenes. The result is versatile for packaging and many display applications.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos calls Theorem an interesting change from the usual calligraphic work of Koziupa and Paul, an art deco font with a 1990s twist.

name: Tierra
classification_notes: A two-weight techno-styled display face (Blanca and Negra) with unique geometric characters.
summary: A two-weight techno-styled display face with unique geometric characters.
description: Tierra keeps its two weights, Blanca and Negra, simple and direct, its techno character built from a small set of distinctive geometric shapes.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes Tierra as a two-weight font with some unique characters and a techno style.

name: Tinkuy Patterns
classification_notes: A non-alphabetic modular pattern system drawn from Andean archaeological motifs rather than a letterform typeface, split into six combinable module files.
summary: A modular pattern system of over 2,650 combinable modules drawn from Andean archaeological motifs.
description: Tinkuy, a Quechua word for the meeting of complementary opposing forces, is born from analysis of visual signs recorded on native Andean archaeological pieces, part of the research project Crónicas Visuales del Abya Yala. Six files of modules combine into an effectively infinite range of textile-like patterns.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos frames Tinkuy Patterns as part of the research project Crónicas Visuales del Abya Yala by designer Vanessa A. Zúñiga Tinizaray.

name: Tiza
classification_notes: A rough, informal script whose flow simulates runny pen ink, offered in two weights (Blanca, Negra) rather than a full weight ramp.
summary: A rough, runny-ink informal script in two weights, suited to handwritten paragraphs and casual greeting cards.
description: Tiza's flow leaves traces simulating runny pen ink, making it suitable for handwriting-like paragraphs as well as casual greeting card and invitation settings. The bold Negra weight fits nicely on book covers and large signs.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos calls Tiza a proverbial reminder that typefaces can sometimes be more human than they are normally perceived.

name: Tropical
classification_notes: A three-face pack (Bold display script, textured Brush script, felt-tip Caps) plus Shapes ornaments, echoing the designer's Venezuelan Caribbean upbringing.
summary: A three-face Caribbean-flavoured lettering pack echoing designer Joluvian's Venezuelan upbringing, with a bonus shapes set.
description: Tropical's bold, wet-looking display script, inky textured brush script and hand-penned felt-tip capitals each work on their own but combine even more deliciously, like a fruit cocktail. Included catchwords, shapes and bursts complete the easygoing Caribbean vibe.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes Tropical as echoing the spirit of designer Joluvian's birthplace, where thick jungles meet endless beaches.

name: Twogether Rounded
classification_notes: A rounded sans built to create a positive, 'feel good' sensation, in the vein of Box, Instagram and Zoom's rounded brand typography, sibling to Twogether Sans.
summary: A friendly, rounded sans built to establish a positive 'feel good' connection, in the tradition of rounded tech-brand typography.
description: Twogether Rounded combines technical design with avant-garde contrasts while keeping an institutional feel, allowing a personal touch to take centre stage. It pairs with the sharper Twogether Sans, sharing proportions and structure.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos notes that brands like Box, Instagram, Skype, Twitter, Vimeo and Zoom have all embraced rounded typography for its friendly, fresh personality.

name: Twogether Sans
classification_notes: Builds on Twogether Rounded by removing its rounded elements for general text use, retaining shared proportions, x-height and italic construction.
summary: A sharp-cornered general-text sans built on Twogether Rounded's proportions, with distinctive alternates for T, Y, y and a.
description: Twogether Sans gains increased flexibility by removing the rounded elements from each character while retaining shared proportions, small caps, ligatures and numerals with its sibling. The lowercase a's old-style eye has been repositioned for legibility, keeping the family consistent while reinforcing its own personality.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes Twogether Sans as building upon the achievements of Twogether Rounded, positioning itself as a suitable choice for general text usage.

name: Uma
classification_notes: A fresh, informal-looking sans whose constructive architecture is more elegant and modern than its first impression suggests.
summary: A fresh, friendly-looking sans in three weights whose constructive architecture reveals itself as elegant and modern.
description: Uma works equally well at large or small sizes, its combination of weights interesting to compose with. Alternates, fractions and ligatures across a wide range of Latin languages suit magazines, brochures, flyers and advertising.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos calls Uma simple at first glance, but very functional and professional, with aesthetic enchanting details.

name: Uplink
classification_notes: An original, upright, connected calligraphic script built with a vertical structure rather than a slanted cursive.
summary: An original upright, connected calligraphic script with a distinctly vertical structure.
description: Uplink keeps its connected letterforms vertical rather than slanted, giving it an original character suited to headlines and packaging that want a calligraphic touch without a cursive lean.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes Uplink as an original, upright, connected, vertical calligraphic script.

name: Utopian
classification_notes: A colour-font geometric sans built on primary colours and pure shapes, the bright counterpart to the black-and-white Dystopian, both sharing the same underlying structure.
summary: A primary-colour geometric colour font influenced by Bauhaus, De Stijl and Art Deco, the bright sibling to the black-and-white Dystopian.
description: Utopian's pure shapes and basic colours are inspired by the beauty of modular order and grid, creating a perfect harmony between its elements. It shares its structure with Dystopian, the two together reflecting divided visions of the future.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes Utopian as a color font family based on primary colors and pure geometric shapes, creating a perfect environment where all elements live in color harmony.

name: Varietta
classification_notes: Expands Alessandro Butti's 1930s Hastile typeface for Nebiolo to 27 static styles, then adds a variable reverse-contrast axis inspired by Spanish market signage.
summary: A reverse-contrast variable superfamily connecting Spanish market-sign lettering with Alessandro Butti's 1930s Hastile design for Nebiolo.
description: Varietta grew from photographing reversed-contrast lettering on Spanish market marquees, then expanding Butti's never-digitised Hastile design to 27 styles from thin condensed to black expanded. Variable-font technology adds a horizontal-contrast axis connecting the Spanish and Italian sources in one typeface.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos traces Varietta to a fascination with photographing the reversed-contrast type designs of Spanish market marquees, connected to Alessandro Butti's 1930s Hastile for Nebiolo.

name: Vastago Grotesk
classification_notes: Inspired by traditional twentieth-century grotesque design, distinguished by particular ink traps resulting from the construction of the G, replicated as a visual theme throughout.
summary: A nine-weight traditional grotesque distinguished by distinctive ink traps born from its G, developed with the Type Crit Crew.
description: Vástago Grotesk's ink traps create a visual theme replicated throughout the system, giving it personality and functional distinctiveness across contexts. It was carefully constructed with advice from typographers worldwide through the Type Crit Crew initiative, running from a subtle Thin to a grandeur-projecting Heavy.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos calls Vástago Grotesk a challenge come true, born out of an interest in exploring the possibilities of sans serif font design.

name: Viento
classification_notes: Described by the foundry as the evolution, devolution and revolution of the classic Brisa font, drawn quickly and roughly for a fast-paced culture.
summary: A rough, quick-drawn evolution of the classic Brisa font, built for a fast-paced culture.
description: Viento is a top-of-the-range option for casual text, invites, recipes, menus and express-lane food packaging, with programmed ligature and kerning features and extended Latin language support.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes Viento as the evolution, devolution and revolution of the classic Brisa font, drawn in a rough way for quick times in a fast culture.

name: Voyeur
classification_notes: Mixes bold, blocky modernism with delicate ornamentals, an unusual combination calculated with deliberate attention rather than a coherent single style.
summary: A calculated mix of bold, blocky modernism with delicate ornamental treatments, adjusted letter by letter.
description: Voyeur includes many different ornamental treatments, each adjusted specifically for its letterform counterpart, with plenty more variation available through the glyph palette.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos says Voyeur attracts two opposite design theories, mixing bold and blocky modernism with delicate ornamentals, calculated with a voyeur's attention to detail.

name: Whomp
classification_notes: Digitises an incomplete Alf Becker poster alphabet from the sign-painter's monthly Signs of the Times series, begun in 1932, rather than a complete original character set.
summary: A bold brush revival of an incomplete 1930s Alf Becker sign-painting poster alphabet.
description: Whomp draws on Becker's monthly Signs of the Times alphabets, begun in 1932 and compiled nine years later into a book that became a sign-painting bestseller. This particular alphabet existed only as words on a poster rather than a full character showing, so Alejandro Paul had to complete the missing letters himself.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos traces Whomp to an incomplete Alf Becker poster alphabet, the American master of sign painting and alphabet manipulation.

name: Wienerin
classification_notes: Revises and expands Olympia, a nearly 100-year-old typeface by Wiener Werkstätte designer Carl Otto Czeschka, an early influence on Bauhaus and art deco.
summary: A revival and expansion of Olympia, a near-100-year-old typeface by Wiener Werkstätte designer Carl Otto Czeschka.
description: Wienerin adapts Czeschka's original for contemporary use with numerous alternative signs and ligatures, plus variable-font technology for a greater range of weights. A repertoire of 500 "einfassungen" frame modules in three weights revives one of the original design's distinguishing features.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos traces Wienerin to Carl Otto Czeschka's work with the Wiener Werkstätte, an early twentieth-century collective influential for Bauhaus, art deco and Scandinavian design.

name: Wild Bloom
classification_notes: A whimsical colour font built from illustrator Juliana Pedemonte's floral lettering, sold with both colour and black-and-white OTF versions.
summary: A whimsical, joy-provoking floral colour font suitable for anything wanting to put smiles on faces.
description: Wild Bloom suits social media posts, logos, stationery, children's books, packaging and typographic posters, with a customisable colour palette and alternate characters. A specially designed black-and-white version with full OpenType support covers Latin languages.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos calls Wild Bloom a whimsical, joy-provoking, soul-comforting colour font suitable for any project that requires putting smiles on faces.

name: Wink
classification_notes: Built on Joluvian's usual calligraphy base but not fully a brush type, giving it a modern, elegant twist on traditional calligraphic flourishes, with matching Caps and Ornaments companions.
summary: A friendly, fun script with a modern twist on traditional calligraphic flourishes, with a matching Caps set and ornaments.
description: Wink appears friendly and fun while carrying a brave, strong creative line intended to feel authentic across media and styles. Its Script and Caps versions can work individually or together, backed by a companion ornaments set.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes Wink as inspired by traditional calligraphic flourishes, with a modern twist that makes it elegant and simple at the same time.

name: Wordless Script
classification_notes: A personal rendition of late eighteenth-century English roundhand as executed with a bird's quill, preserving the irregular finish of a pointed nib rather than a smoothed digital revival.
summary: A Rococo-spirited revival of late eighteenth-century English roundhand, preserving the irregular finish of a quill-drawn pointed nib.
description: Wordless Script is meant for writing the things that go beyond words, based on the connected scripts of late 1700s England. Its neoclassical, romantic character radiates the gallantry of an earlier, more gracious era.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos describes Wordless Script as the font of choice for writing those things that go beyond words, style, charm and emotion over simple legibility.

name: Zulia Pro
classification_notes: Joluvian's first typographic project, based on his two favourite calligraphic styles, italic and brush pen, built from handmade forms connectable in different ways.
summary: A heavier, low-rise italic/brush-pen hybrid script, Joluvian's first typographic project, named for his mother's home region in Venezuela.
description: Zulia started with simple, contrasted strokes on paper using brush and marker before developing into a full alphabet with connectable handmade forms for each letter. It later gained fuller shape through Alejandro Paul's collaboration and technical feedback.
foundry_blurb: Sudtipos says Zulia is not just a typeface, Zulia is Joluvian's love of letters, named to honour his mother's home region in western Venezuela.
